The '''Bronze Cluster''' was an embellishment of the [[Kalidor Crescent/Legends|Kalidor Crescent]] which was given to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] who had already earned the decoration for acts of heroism and superior piloting skill. In order of precedence, it was the first of five such embellishments.
